Title: Admin users
Description: Administrators need to invite a separate user, control access, reset passwords and remove accounts when required.
Notes: Secure invite, role, suspend, reset and delete APIs are implemented. Run 20260722-user-management-hardening.sql and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.handlineco.com before production use.

Title: Admin portal log in bug
Description: Any new browser does not bring me to the admin log-in page. If I log out of my session, I have no way to log back in. Trying to log in on a new browser briefly shows the admin dashboard before reverting to the normal website.
Notes: Signed-out visits to /admin now go to login with the intended destination retained. Admin content remains hidden until role verification completes, and logging out now goes directly to login.

Title: NO access to website
Description: Multiple customers in the UK and Europe reported that their IT systems block the website because its category is unknown. A prospect in Spain supplied a Zscaler block-page screenshot.
Notes: The live site and affected product URL return HTTP 200 with valid TLS. This is a Zscaler URL-categorisation issue, not a code or availability issue. Customer IT teams can allowlist handlineco.com and www.handlineco.com; submit the domain to Zscaler Site Review for categorisation.

Title: Clothing sub-category not filtering
Description: The Clothing category has three sub-categories, but selecting one does not filter products accordingly. It works in the admin portal. JK10 is currently the only welding product but products appear in every sub-category.
Notes: Public Clothing sub-category pages now use the existing product-category mapping and display only products assigned to the relevant clothing type.

Title: Clothing data input (SIZE)
Description: Inputting a size for a new clothing product does not show on the published product. Example: Article JK10.
Notes: Published Clothing specifications now derive the display value from saved minimum and maximum clothing sizes, for example XS–XL, with the legacy text field retained as a fallback.

Title: Clothing filter does not work
Description: Using the Work Environment filter in the Clothing section makes all products disappear. Other filters work correctly.
Notes: The filter now uses environment-pictogram data. Work Environment controls are available when creating and editing Clothing products; existing products need their applicable environments selected and saved.

Title: Respiratory protection / standards
Description: EN 12941 is missing and needs a string display similar to EN 166. EN 397 is also reported as missing, with no text display required.
Notes: EN 12941 is supported in the admin, cards, preview, safety detail and filtering. KAIOS was backfilled and verified with EN 12941 TH3 and EN 143 P3. EN 397 was verified as already present on Thermo Boss.

Title: Preview missing Clothing safety details
Description: Clothing safety features do not show in product-list previews on the homepage, although the category product-grid preview works correctly.
Notes: Homepage featured-product cards now display Clothing safety standards, including high-visibility, flame, welding, arc, antistatic, chemical, weather and UV standards.

Title: Eye category filter
Description: The Coating filter does not use values from the database and only filters pre-loaded products. Other category filters work correctly.
Notes: The filter now reads localised coatings from the current admin form, with English and legacy-data fallbacks. Its options and matching logic use the same source as the published product specification.

Title: Head category filter
Description: Brim Length is duplicated and does not take values in every language. EN 812 could not initially be selected, then began working after other filters were selected; the issue could not be reproduced.
Notes: Brim Length now uses the saved localised Head technical-specification value with legacy fallback, and normalises values to prevent duplicates. New Head products save technical specifications on creation. EN 812 uses the same selection logic as other Head standards; no repeatable fault was found.

Title: Head protection Safety standard bug
Description: Thermo Boss crashes when Safety is opened in the admin portal and does not show the correct standards on the website. The same error was reported for MACSOLE and 1 x-craft S3 after saving and returning to Safety.
Notes: Safety editors now normalise incomplete or empty legacy locale data and safely handle legacy footwear standard values that are not arrays. Public pages recognise category-specific safety standards and retain legacy Head and Footwear data fallbacks.

Title: Arm protection
Description: Length data does not pull through or show on the product page.
Notes: Arm Protection length is mirrored to the shared length field when an Arm product is created or saved. Public Arm pages and length filters retain the arm-specific value as a fallback for existing products.

Title: Arm protection - LANGUAGE
Description: Product specifications and Arm Protection Attributes do not translate into Italian.
Notes: Arm Protection labels, Yes/No values and closure types now use translations. Italian closure values display as Velcro, Elastico and Nessuno. Materials fall back to English when an Italian value is not yet supplied.

Title: Footer
Description: Sectors does not include all sectors.
Notes: The footer now loads and displays every industry in the database using the active language. New sectors added in admin appear automatically, with a link to the full Industries page.
